dct_title_s: Nieuwe en Naauwkeurige Kaart van het Zuidlyk Gedeelte van Africa ... verbeeterd door W.A. Bachiene
dct_description_sm: This is a Dutch version of the 1747 English edition of Bowen's map (see NOR 0170); Prime meridian through London.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0176, p. 199
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0176.
